about: T268: the launch budget. Ceilings in ms per stage of GET /debug/launch (shared launch/Launch.kt) and for the first frame and the map drawn, against the medians of tools/android-startup.py --warmup 1 --launches 9 (cold, a seeded store; T306: the warm-up launch is measured and left out of the medians) in the sweep's startup part; a median over its ceiling, or a StrictMode kind a stage's declared work does not allow, turns the part red.
rule: Set by android-startup.py --set-budget from the medians of at least eight startup.json reports in sweep conditions (T306; the first ceilings: three sweeps of 2026-11-13): the largest times the factor, rounded up to whole ms, and never under that median plus floorMs (one frame at 60 Hz; a stage of a few ms swings by more than a quarter of itself). It never lowers a ceiling: one the reports would set lower keeps its value and says so in kept (the date it was set; the reports are of the part alone after a boot, a full sweep reads some stages slower). Lower a ceiling by hand in the commit that lands an improvement; never raise one without a line in the dated log. A renamed stage keeps its ceiling through aliases, {old name: new name}.
